User Acceptance Testing: Study Planner System

Do each test case, mark the result, and write what you saw. Your answers are saved in this browser while you work. Do not write student IDs, names or grades.

About this session

What the client asked for

Must: the client asked for it. All must pass. Agreed: the team proposed it and the client agreed. The tag of each test shows which it is.

R1Match a student's DPA results to the study planners, to infer the course, the major and the progression in the course.Must
R2Import a student's data from the university portal (by API requests), for one student at a time, on demand.Must
R3Enter a student's data by hand when the portal is not available (manual fallback).Must
R4Import and read official study planner PDFs with a local text-extraction pipeline.Must
R5Export the analysis results to Excel.Must
R6Student data stays transient: only in memory during the session, never stored by the app.Must
R7Show the graduation status and whether the prerequisites of each unit are met (the problem statement).Must
R8Class estimation: estimate how many students take a unit next semester.Must
R9Student pathway generator: the best pathway that lets the student graduate under the matched planner.Must
R10AI Copilot: ask questions in plain English instead of using the screens and buttons.Agreed
R11Student-facing web app (with its CMS), so that advisors do not answer the basic questions.Agreed

TC-03
Import one student from the portal
Must R2

2. Type the ID of Student A and select Load.
Expected: Only that student loads, when asked. The summary, the ranked planners and the result tabs show.

Must R2 R3

2. Log out of the portal and look up a student again.
Expected: The app says that it found no student, and later tells the tester to log in or to use Import. It does not crash and does not show an empty or wrong result.

Notes: what you saw, what was confusing

Must R3

2. Choose the transcript file of the data pack, enter the intake and select Load.

Expected: The student loads and the match runs, with the same result as for a portal student. The bad file gives a clear message and loads nothing.

Notes: what you saw, what was confusing

2. Open it for Student A (cannot graduate).

Notes: what you saw, what was confusing

Notes: what you saw, what was confusing

Expected: Each edit works. The move that breaks a rule shows a warning.

Notes: what you saw, what was confusing

Notes: what you saw, what was confusing
